title: IMU sensor breakout board (electronics + firmware)
goal: A small breakout board exposing an I2C IMU (MPU-6050 class) on a 0.1-inch header, powered by a 3.3 V LDO from a 5 V USB input, with decoupling and two mounting holes. Board must fit within 25 x 20 mm.

requirements: input/output voltages quantified (5 V in, 3.3 V rail)
design: board outline / mechanical envelope authored and committed
electronics: schematic topology defined (IMU + LDO + decoupling + header)
simulation: ERC/DRC or a design check noted
